title: Reranker CoreML fp16 latency
finding: fp16 crashes on ORT 1.25.1 (`SimplifiedLayerNormFusion` bug) but fixable with `disabled_optimizers`. With fix: fp16+CoreML loads but is 2.3× slower than int8+CPU (5393ms vs 2348ms P50). CoreML does not accelerate cross-encoder models. Keep int8+CPU as swap default; add `disabled_optimizers` safety net to `reranker.py`
